# Endless Asteroid Dodge

Control a ship on an HTML canvas, moving freely while asteroids spawn from the edges and drift inward. Shoot to destroy them; the game speeds up over time. **Lose condition:** the ship collides with any asteroid.

<content>
1: // Endless Asteroid Dodge
2: // Simple canvas game: ship moves with arrow keys/WASD, shoots with space. Added basic sound effects using Web Audio API.
3: // Asteroids spawn from edges and drift inward. Game speeds up over time.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   /*** Setup ***/
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9:   // Audio setup
10:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
11:   function playTone(freq, duration) {
12:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
13:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
14:     osc.type = 'sine';
15:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
16:     osc.connect(gain);
17:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
18:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
19:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
20:     osc.start();
21:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
22:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
23:   }
24:   const width = canvas.width;
25:   const height = canvas.height;
26: 
27:   /*** Game state ***/
28:   const ship = { x: width / 2, y: height / 2, r: 10, angle: 0, speed: 2 };
29:   const bullets = [];
30:   const asteroids = [];
31:   let keys = {};
32:   let lastSpawn = 0;
33:   let spawnInterval = 2000; // ms
34:   let lastTime = 0;
35:   let gameOver = false;
36:   let score = 0;
37:   let speedFactor = 1;
38: 
39:   /*** Input ***/
40:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
41:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
42: 
43:   /*** Helpers ***/
44:   function randRange(min, max) { return Math.random() * (max - min) + min; }
45:   function distance(ax, ay, bx, by) { return Math.hypot(ax - bx, ay - by); }
46: 
47:   /*** Entity creation ***/
48:   function spawnAsteroid() {
49:     // choose edge
50:     const edge = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
51:     let x, y, vx, vy;
52:     const radius = randRange(8, 20) * speedFactor;
53:     const speed = randRange(0.5, 1.5) * speedFactor;
54:     if (edge === 0) { // top
55:       x = randRange(0, width);
56:       y = -radius;
57:     } else if (edge === 1) { // right
58:       x = width + radius;
59:       y = randRange(0, height);
60:     } else if (edge === 2) { // bottom
61:       x = randRange(0, width);
62:       y = height + radius;
63:     } else { // left
64:       x = -radius;
65:       y = randRange(0, height);
66:     }
67:     // drift toward center
68:     const dx = width / 2 - x;
69:     const dy = height / 2 - y;
70:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
71:     vx = (dx / len) * speed;
72:     vy = (dy / len) * speed;
73:     asteroids.push({ x, y, vx, vy, r: radius });
74:   }
75: 
76:   function fireBullet() {
77:     const angle = ship.angle;
78:     const speed = 5 * speedFactor;
79:     bullets.push({
80:       x: ship.x + Math.cos(angle) * ship.r,
81:       y: ship.y + Math.sin(angle) * ship.r,
82:       vx: Math.cos(angle) * speed,
83:       vy: Math.sin(angle) * speed,
84:       r: 2,
85:     });
86:   }
87: 
88:   /*** Game loop ***/
89:   function update(dt) {
90:     // Ship movement
91:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) ship.y -= ship.speed * speedFactor;
92:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) ship.y += ship.speed * speedFactor;
93:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.x -= ship.speed * speedFactor;
94:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.x += ship.speed * speedFactor;
95:     // Keep ship inside canvas
96:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(width, ship.x));
97:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(height, ship.y));
98:     // Ship angle faces mouse? use direction of last movement
99:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) ship.angle = -Math.PI / 2;
100:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) ship.angle = Math.PI / 2;
101:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.angle = Math.PI;
102:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.angle = 0;
103:     // Shooting
104:     if (keys[' ']) { // space bar
105:       if (!keys['_spaceCooldown']) {
106:         fireBullet();
107:         keys['_spaceCooldown'] = true;
108:         setTimeout(() => (keys['_spaceCooldown'] = false), 200);
109:       }
110:     }
111:     // Update bullets
112:     bullets.forEach(b => { b.x += b.vx * dt; b.y += b.vy * dt; });
113:     // Remove off‑screen bullets
114:     for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
115:       const b = bullets[i];
116:       if (b.x < 0 || b.x > width || b.y < 0 || b.y > height) bullets.splice(i, 1);
117:     }
118:     // Update asteroids
119:     asteroids.forEach(a => { a.x += a.vx * dt; a.y += a.vy * dt; });
120:     // Collision: ship vs asteroids
121:     for (const a of asteroids) {
122:       if (distance(ship.x, ship.y, a.x, a.y) < ship.r + a.r) {
123:         gameOver = true;
124:         break;
125:       }
126:     }
127:     // Collision: bullets vs asteroids
128:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
129:       const a = asteroids[i];
130:       let hit = false;
131:       for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
132:         const b = bullets[j];
133:         if (distance(b.x, b.y, a.x, a.y) < b.r + a.r) {
134:           hit = true;
135:           bullets.splice(j, 1);
136:           break;
137:         }
138:       }
139:       if (hit) {
140:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
141:         score++;
142:       }
143:     }
144:     // Spawn new asteroids
145:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval / speedFactor) {
146:       spawnAsteroid();
147:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
148:     }
149:     // Gradually increase difficulty
150:     speedFactor = 1 + score * 0.05;
151:   }
152: 
153:   // Create a starfield background once
154: const stars = [];
155: for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
156:   stars.push({ x: Math.random() * width, y: Math.random() * height, radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5 });
157: }
158: 
159: function draw() {
160:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
161:     // Ship
162:     ctx.save();
163:     ctx.translate(ship.x, ship.y);
164:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
165:     ctx.fillStyle = 'cyan';
166:     ctx.beginPath();
167:     ctx.moveTo(ship.r, 0);
168:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, -ship.r / 2);
169:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.r, ship.r / 2);
170:     ctx.closePath();
171:     ctx.fill();
172:     ctx.restore();
173:     // Bullets
174:     ctx.fillStyle = 'yellow';
175:     bullets.forEach(b => {
176:       ctx.beginPath();
177:       ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
178:       ctx.fill();
179:     });
180:     // Asteroids
181:     ctx.fillStyle = 'gray';
182:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
183:       ctx.beginPath();
184:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
185:       ctx.fill();
186:     });
187:     // UI
188:     ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
189:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
190:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
191:     if (gameOver) {
192:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
193:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
194:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
195:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
196:     }
197:   }
198: 
199:   function loop(timestamp) {
200:     if (!lastTime) lastTime = timestamp;
201:     const dt = (timestamp - lastTime) / 16.666; // normalize to ~60fps units
202:     lastTime = timestamp;
203:     if (!gameOver) update(dt);
204:     draw();
205:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
206:   }
207: 
208:   // Start
209:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
210: })();

(End of file - total 210 lines)
</content>
